quote: The quiet nights always demand a heavy toll. You stare at ceilings painted with ghosts. Every memory returns to haunt your peace. We replay conversations that ended too soon. Words unsaid linger in the empty room. You cannot outrun the shadow of regret. Some grief stays long after the sun sets.
